verdict.rationale: The Washington Secretary of State is a government filing and records office for business registrations, charities, apostilles, elections and archives, not a hosted data service. Letting a user pick a storage region or residency for their data is not a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows any user-selectable storage location that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
